name: NBHD Cron Enforcement
description: Fire-time OUTBOUND enforcement for typed cron patterns. Observes cron_changed to cache a firing cron's baked nbhd.v1 contract (parsed from CronJob.data.description) per session/run, then evaluates every dispatched nbhd_send_to_user call at before_tool_call — pass, rewrite to safe content, or block-and-revise (bounded) — before the message ever leaves the container. Zero Django calls at fire time: the contract travels with the job, baked at create/save time by apps/cron/signals.py. Registers no tools. See CONTINUITY_cron-typed-patterns.md.

cacheTtlSeconds.description: How long a cached firing-session contract lives before forced expiry. Default 600s.
